_about: A small, fictional-but-plausible web for FAKE_MODE and the offline eval. Each page is visible from `from` until `to` (by the injected clock), so prices can change between days. Numbers here are test fixtures, not real prices.

pages.title: Pricing | Supabase
pages.text: Supabase: the Pro plan costs $25 per month. Includes 8 GB database and daily backups. Supabase: the Team plan costs $599 per month.

pages.title: Neon Pricing - Serverless Postgres
pages.text: Neon: the Launch plan costs $19 per month. Neon: the Scale plan costs $69 per month. Autoscaling and branching included.

pages.title: Neon Pricing - Serverless Postgres
pages.text: Neon: the Launch plan costs $15 per month. Neon: the Scale plan costs $69 per month. New lower Launch price from 14 November 2026.

pages.title: We cut the Launch plan price
pages.text: Neon: the Launch plan costs $15 per month, down from $19, effective 14 November 2026. Postgres hosting news.

pages.title: Railway Pricing - Postgres hosting
pages.text: Railway: the Hobby plan costs $5 per month. Usage-based Postgres hosting on top.

pages.title: Best managed Postgres hosting in 2026
pages.text: A roundup of Postgres hosting: Supabase, Neon and Railway compared on price, branching and backups.
